title: Matthew Brown snuck into secret congressional briefing

tellings.quote: Um I snuck him in, you know, to have a secret congressional briefing with three members who all said yes to me.

plain: A man named Jeremy Corbell says that sometime between 2024 and 2026 in Washington he "snuck" a man named Matthew Brown into a secret briefing with three members of Congress, who all said yes to Corbell's request. Corbell tells Michels he set it up himself, which would mean Brown's account reached lawmakers behind closed doors.
